QuestInfo.name: Identity of the Missile
QuestInfo.1: Andy the Time Traveler has asked you to travel to the year 2215 to investigate the Bombed City Center and destroy the A.I. missile known as Dunas.
QuestInfo.2: Andy the Time Traveler told you to go to Year 2215: Bombed City Center to find Dunas, the intelligent warhead responsible for all the destruction. When you found Dunas, it appeared as a human-type android. You were able to destroy Dunas, but the city looks like it is beyond help...

0.0: I have an assignment for you in the year 2215. That year was the worst year in history, when the evolved robots bombed the City Center. The A.I. missile that bombed the City Center was called Dunas. Please travel to year 2215 and destroy the missile.

yes.0: There isn't much recorded about Dunas. I don't even know what it looks like. All I can tell you is to be extra careful out there.

no.0: What, are you getting scared? It's too late. Think about it. You've seen too much. You know too much about the future at this point.

1.0: Dunas is an android? Was that possible in 2215? Something doesn't add up.

yes.0: I have a bad feeling about this. I feel like we're missing a huge piece of the puzzle.

mob.0: The A.I. missile that bombed the City Center was called Dunas. Please travel to year 2215 and destroy the missile.
